lines.trans: Hand me the small brass screws from your pocket, Qing.
One, two. Is the new copper wire connected all the way to the box?
Brand-new wire, new porcelain fuse, and zero old cloth left in the wall.
The brass switch plate sits straight and tight against the brick.
Step down clear of the ladder. Ready to test it properly, Qing?
Should we call Manager Zhou to flip the switch?
Not a chance. Your turn, Qing—one clean click.
Here goes... click! Oh, look at that warm golden light!
The frosted glass shade spreads soft light across every windowpane!
Listen to the kitchen too—no pop, and the oven is still humming.
Room Nine officially has light after thirty dark years!
Wait—look at the shadow inside the open piano lid, Qing!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yī. Changes tone to yí before 4th tone (一个 yí gè) and yì before 1st/2nd/3rd tones (一杯 yì bēi).

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yí xià. Placed after an action verb to make a request or suggestion sound casual and brief (看一下, 等一下).

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yì diǎn. Before a noun, means 'a little bit of' (一点糖); after an adjective, 'a bit more' (快一点).

examples.text: 只有一点点牛奶、两个鸡蛋，一点黄油都没有！
examples.trans: Only a tiny bit of milk, two eggs, and no butter at all!

examples.text: 太好了！请加牛奶和一点糖。
examples.trans: Wonderful! With milk and a little sugar, please.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yì zhí. Describes walking straight (一直走) or doing something non-stop.

examples.text: 出大门往左拐，一直走到石桥。
examples.trans: Go out the front gate, turn left, and walk straight to the stone bridge.

examples.text: 志豪先生！您一直站在后面吗？！
examples.trans: Mr Zhihao! Were you standing right there behind us?!

meanings.note: Pinyin: sān shí. Cardinal number thirty ('three tens'); pairs directly with measure words like 三十年 ('thirty years').

examples.text: 这棵老树在院子里长了三十年。
examples.trans: This old tree has grown in the courtyard for thirty years.

examples.text: 从客栈走到地铁站只要三十分钟。
examples.trans: Walking from the inn to the metro station takes only thirty minutes.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shàng. Used both as a directional verb/complement ('up, onto') and location word ('on top of').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bù. Standard negation for present/future/habitual verbs and adjectives; shifts to bú before a 4th tone (不是 bú shì).

examples.text: 下雨的时候，纸不会弄丢房间名单。
examples.trans: When it rains, paper will not lose the room list.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

meanings.note: Pinyin: liǎng. Used instead of 二 when counting things with a measure word (两个, 两把, 两间).

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǔ. Cardinal number 9.

examples.text: 晚上九点？你站这儿，我们一起去开门。
examples.trans: Nine in the evening? Stay right here; let us go open the gate together.

examples.text: 九分钟！牛奶、鸡蛋和苹果都买来了！
examples.trans: Nine minutes! The milk, eggs, and apples are all here!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yě. Always stands directly before the verb or adjective, never at the end of a clause.

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 周经理早！桌子很干净，钥匙也准备好了。
examples.trans: Morning, Manager Zhou! The desk is clean, and the keys are ready too.

meanings.note: Pinyin: le. After a verb, marks completion; at the end of a sentence, signals a change of situation.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liàng. Describes bright light or a surface polished clean (擦亮 'polish bright').

examples.text: 隔壁的小洗手间呢？灯亮吗？
examples.trans: What about the small bathroom next door? Does the light work?

examples.text: 火苗亮了——稳稳的蓝火，正合适。
examples.trans: The flame is lit—steady blue fire, right as it should be.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǐ hòu. Measure word (量词): 段, e.g. 以后的时间 ('time afterward').

examples.text: 三年前爷爷去世以后，我和志鹏因为卖老房子大吵了一架。
examples.trans: Three years ago after Grandfather passed away, Zhipeng and I argued bitterly over selling the old house.

examples.text: 十二点以后再拆吧，老板！看钟：差五分十二点！
examples.trans: Open it after twelve, boss! Look at the clock: five minutes to twelve!

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǐ. Everyday singular 'you' among colleagues, friends, and peers; use 您 for polite respect.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

meanings.note: Pinyin: báo xiǎn sī. Measure word (量词): 根 (gēn), e.g. 一根保险丝 ('a fuse').

examples.text: 是旧电线，把一楼的保险丝烧断了。
examples.trans: It was the old wire—it blew the ground-floor fuse.

examples.text: 老陈，午饭以前能修好吗？你有新的保险丝吧？
examples.trans: Chen, can you fix it before lunch? You do have new fuses, right?

meanings.note: Pinyin: guāng. Rays of light or brightness (阳光 'sunlight', 灯光 'lamplight').

examples.text: 早上的光从玻璃窗照进阳光房里。
examples.trans: Morning light shines through the glass windows into the sunroom.

examples.text: 换上新灯泡以后，屋子里的光很柔和。
examples.trans: After putting in the new bulb, the light in the room is very gentle.

meanings.note: Pinyin: quán xīn. Stronger than 新 ('completely brand-new').

examples.text: 您看，这件软羊毛开衫是全新的，试试吧。
examples.trans: Look, this soft wool cardigan is brand-new; try it on.

examples.text: 浴室里刚换上了全新的铜阀门。
examples.trans: Brand-new brass valves were just fitted in the bathroom.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài. Marks a next step in sequence (先提再推) or a future repetition (再见 'see you again').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǔn bèi. Used for preparing rooms, breakfast, or plans.

examples.text: 大家早上好！欢迎你，小晴。都准备好了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning, everyone! Welcome, Qing. Is everything ready?

examples.text: 周经理早！桌子很干净，钥匙也准备好了。
examples.trans: Morning, Manager Zhou! The desk is clean, and the keys are ready too.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dào. Works as main verb ('arrive') or result complement ('succeed in reaching/perceiving', 找到, 听到).

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房今天到。
examples.trans: Right, eight guest rooms, eight brass keys. Room four arrives today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chú fáng. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间厨房 ('a kitchen').

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

examples.text: 糟了！周经理，小晴，厨房出急事了！
examples.trans: Oh no! Manager Zhou, Qing, we have a kitchen emergency!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yòu. Marks an action repeating, or pairs two qualities in 又A又B ('both A and B').

examples.text: 真的可以吗？看着又好看又暖和！
examples.trans: Is that really alright? It looks both lovely and warm!

examples.text: 又是深蓝色行李箱！这是宋老师的吗？
examples.trans: Another dark-blue suitcase! Is this Teacher Song's?

meanings.note: Pinyin: kǒu dài. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个口袋 ('a pocket').

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

examples.text: 告诉他们，我箱子上面口袋里有红丝带！
examples.trans: Tell them there is a red ribbon inside the top pocket of my case!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiào. Introduces a person's given or full name (我叫小晴 'My name is Xiaoqing') or calls a cab.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

meanings.note: Pinyin: hào. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个号码 ('a number').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房今天到。
examples.trans: Right, eight guest rooms, eight brass keys. Room four arrives today.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ma. Placed at the end of any statement to turn it into a neutral yes/no question.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.en: have a listen; listen a bit
meanings.note: Pinyin: tīng ting. Reduplicated verb making an invitation to listen warm and unhurried.

examples.text: 听听他说的！老陈比我们好奇两倍！
examples.trans: Listen to him! Chen is twice as curious as we are!

examples.text: 听听保养大师说的！昨天修热水器，今天修两兄弟！
examples.trans: Listen to the maintenance master! Yesterday fixing the boiler, today fixing two brothers!

meanings.note: Pinyin: kā dā. Onomatopoeia imitating the crisp snap of a light switch, lock, or latch.

examples.text: 咔嗒一声，铜锁终于打开了。
examples.trans: With a crisp click, the brass lock finally opened.

examples.text: 她按下墙上的开关，咔嗒一声灯就亮了。
examples.trans: She pressed the wall switch, and with a click the lamp came on.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wā. Expresses admiration or delight.

examples.text: 哇，看这间房！大木头房梁，窗户正对着院子！
examples.trans: Wow, look at this room! Big wooden beams, and a window facing the courtyard!

examples.text: 插上老陈的铜台灯……哇，黄色灯光真暖和！
examples.trans: Plug in Chen's brass lamp... wow, how warm that yellow light is!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎng. Used for bells, phones, pipes, or alarms ringing or clanking.

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

meanings.note: Pinyin: la. Colloquial fusion of 了 + 啊 adding cheerful energy at the end of a sentence.

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 你们守着，我出门啦！
examples.trans: Hold the fort—I am heading out the door!

meanings.note: Pinyin: pā. Sound word for a sharp crack, a slap, or a blown fuse.

examples.text: 就按一下——啪！……哎呀。
examples.trans: Just one quick click—pop! ... Oh dear.

examples.text: 啪的一声，杯子掉在地上了。
examples.trans: With a snap, the cup fell to the floor.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wēng wēng. Onomatopoeia describing the low hum of an appliance, bee, or transformer.

examples.text: 新冰箱在角落里轻轻地嗡嗡响。
examples.trans: The new fridge hums softly in the corner.

examples.text: 春天花园里的蜜蜂在花朵旁嗡嗡飞。
examples.trans: In spring, bees in the garden buzz around the blossoms.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huí tóu. Appears in the friendly farewell 回头见！ ('See you soon!').

examples.text: 我先去送热茶，我们回头聊！
examples.trans: Let me deliver this hot tea first—we will talk soon!

examples.text: 今天辛苦了，回头见！
examples.trans: Great work today—see you soon!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài. As main verb/preposition, gives location (在院子里); before another verb, marks ongoing action ('be doing').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Neutral-tone structural particle turning a descriptive phrase into an adverb before a verb (轻轻地放 'set down gently'); distinct from noun di4 ('ground').

examples.text: 小晴整整齐齐地把茶杯排在木架上。
examples.trans: Qing arranged the teacups neatly on the wooden shelf.

examples.text: 老陈仔细地检查了每一根新电线。
examples.trans: Chen carefully checked every single new wire.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qiáng. Measure word (量词): 堵 (dǔ), e.g. 一堵墙 ('a wall').

examples.text: 拐弯小心点，别碰到墙！
examples.trans: Careful on the turn—do not bump the wall!

examples.text: 当然记得！每到星期五弹错一个音，他就对着墙皱眉头。
examples.trans: Of course I remember! Every Friday when he missed a note, he frowned at the wall.

meanings.en: sound; voice; measure word for sounds
meanings.note: Pinyin: shēng. Counts cries, knocks, or chimes (一声 'one sound').

examples.text: 来不及了！他说了声谢谢就挂断了！
examples.trans: Too late! He said thank you and hung up!

examples.text: 非常安静！不过刚才你听到奇怪的金属敲击声了吗？
examples.trans: Very quiet! Though did you hear a strange metallic knocking sound just now?

meanings.note: Pinyin: hǎo. Main adjective 'good'; as a result complement after a verb, means 'ready/completed properly' (修好, 准备好).

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo. Everyday adjective for small size; also prefixes younger colleagues' names warmly (小晴, 小美).

examples.text: 早上好，小姑娘。我订了房间，我姓宋。
examples.trans: Good morning, young lady. I booked a room; my surname is Song.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

meanings.note: Pinyin: bù. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块布 ('a piece of cloth').

examples.text: 周经理，给您干净布和冷水。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou, here is a clean cloth and cold water for you.

examples.text: 请拿一块干净的布擦桌子。
examples.trans: Please take a clean cloth to wipe the table.

related.gloss: a piece of cloth (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: gān cuì. Suggests cutting straight to a clean solution.

examples.text: 大门门铃响了。干脆有力的一下。
examples.trans: There goes the gate bell. One firm, decisive ring.

examples.text: 既然雨这么大，干脆留下来吃晚饭吧。
examples.trans: Since it is raining this hard, you might as well stay for dinner.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nián. Time classifier taking no 个 directly after numbers (六年 'six years', 今年 'this year').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 老橡木，八十年了，一滴水都不漏。
examples.trans: Old oak, eighty years old—not a single drop leaks.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kāi guān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个开关 ('a switch').

examples.text: 周经理，等一分钟，先别碰那个铜开关。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou, wait a minute—don't touch that brass switch yet.

examples.text: 老板，这是三十年的老电线。我检查以前，千万别按开关。
examples.trans: Boss, this wire is thirty years old. Never flip a switch before I check it.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǐng zi. Second syllable neutral tone. Measure word: 个 (gè) or 道 (dào).

examples.text: 夕阳把竹子的影子投在白墙上。
examples.trans: The setting sun casts the bamboo's shadow onto the white wall.

examples.text: 灯光下，我看见琴盖后面有一个白纸影子。
examples.trans: Under the lamplight, I spotted the shadow of white paper behind the piano lid.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ. First-person singular pronoun; add 的 for 'my' (我的) and 们 for 'we/us' (我们).

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fáng. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间房 ('a room').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房今天到。
examples.trans: Right, eight guest rooms, eight brass keys. Room four arrives today.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

扇.gloss: measure word for doors and windows

meanings.en: measure word for doors and windows
meanings.note: Pinyin: shàn. Counts hinged or sliding doors and windows (一扇门 'a door', 一扇窗户 'a window').

examples.text: 上楼梯，平台往左拐，最上面最后一扇门。
examples.trans: Up the stairs, turn left at the landing, last door at the very top.

examples.text: 再往左拐进小广场，找一扇蓝木门。
examples.trans: Then turn left into the small square and look for a blue wooden door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dǎ kāi. Result compound for opening suitcases, envelopes, boxes, or laptops.

examples.text: 我的行李箱！快打开上面口袋……对，红丝带！
examples.trans: My suitcase! Let me open the top pocket... yes, the red ribbon!

examples.text: 先生？他说：请别打开白纸包，我星期五中午来。
examples.trans: Sir? He says: Please do not open the white paper parcel; I will come Friday at noon.

meanings.en: measure word for handled objects; disposal marker
meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎ. Counts items with handles or backs (一把钥匙, 一把椅子); as a preposition, fronts a definite object before an action verb.

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房今天到。
examples.trans: Right, eight guest rooms, eight brass keys. Room four arrives today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: àn. Used for pressing a doorbell, elevator button, or key (按门铃).

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 宋老师，怎么了？您按了门铃！
examples.trans: Teacher Song, what happened? You rang the bell!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīn. Everyday adjective for new people, items, or beginnings.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 放心吧，周经理。房间干净，毛巾也是新的。
examples.trans: Relax, Manager Zhou. The room is clean, and the towels are fresh.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù. Describes old houses, pipes, or letters—never a person's age (use 老 for people).

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 不在，只有我的笔和三张旧收据！
examples.trans: Not there—only my pen and three old receipts!

meanings.note: Pinyin: lái. Movement toward the speaker, as main verb or directional complement (进来 'come in').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 大门口正好来了一辆出租车。
examples.trans: A taxi has just pulled up right at the front gate.

meanings.note: Pinyin: róu hé. Describes soothing light, warm colours, or gentle acoustic tones.

examples.text: 磨砂玻璃让顶灯的光线变得非常柔和。
examples.trans: Frosted glass makes the light from the ceiling lamp wonderfully soft.

examples.text: 傍晚柔和的阳光照在院子的石桌子上。
examples.trans: Soft late-afternoon sunlight falls across the stone table in the courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tī zi. Second syllable neutral tone. Measure word: 把 (bǎ) or 架 (jià).

examples.text: 老陈站在木梯子上换天花板顶灯的电线。
examples.trans: Chen stood on the wooden stepladder replacing the wires for the ceiling lamp.

examples.text: 爬梯子的时候，下面最好有人帮忙扶着。
examples.trans: When climbing a ladder, it is best to have someone steady it from below.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèng shì. Describes formal speech or a permanent job after probation.

examples.text: 我一紧张，句子就变得又长又正式！
examples.trans: Whenever I get nervous, my sentences turn long and formal!

examples.text: 周经理，要是你不正式聘用她，我就请她进我厨房！
examples.trans: Manager Zhou, if you do not hire her permanently, I am hiring her into my kitchen!

meanings.note: Pinyin: bù. Counts footsteps or stages (一步 'one step').

examples.text: 真的？您不介意多爬几步楼梯？
examples.trans: Really? You do not mind climbing a few extra stairs?

examples.text: 茶壶也烫好了！大家从窗边退后一步！
examples.trans: And the teapot is hot! Everybody step back from the window!

meanings.note: Pinyin: měi. Usually followed by a measure word (每个星期 'every week', 每位客人 'every guest').

examples.text: 每个蓝杯子旁边放一张餐巾和一把小勺子。
examples.trans: Beside every blue cup, put one napkin and one small spoon.

examples.text: 老房子每到星期二就松一颗螺丝。坐吧。
examples.trans: Every Tuesday an old house loosens one screw. Sit down.

meanings.note: Pinyin: méi. Short form of 没有; negates 有 and past/completed actions (没锁 'isn't locked / didn't lock').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.en: not have; there is not; did not
meanings.note: Pinyin: méi yǒu. Negates 有 ('have / there is') and past actions.

examples.text: 可惜没有电话号码，只有两个字母和老街名字。
examples.trans: Unfortunately there is no phone number, only two letters and an old street name.

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

meanings.note: Pinyin: sǎ. Used for liquids spilling out of a cup or pot.

examples.text: 天哪！桌子上一滴没洒……全洒在我领带上了！
examples.trans: Good heavens! Not a drop spilled on the table... it all spilled on my tie!

examples.text: 小心端稳，别把热茶洒出来。
examples.trans: Carry it steadily so you do not spill the hot tea.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wēn nuǎn. Warmer and more emotional than plain 暖; used for sunshine, sound, and kindness.

examples.text: 听……有点低，很温暖，等等——中间这个琴键没有声音！
examples.trans: Listen... a little low, very warm, and wait—this middle key makes no sound!

examples.text: 谢谢你，你的话让我很温暖。
examples.trans: Thank you, your words make me feel warm inside.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dēng. Measure word (量词): 盏 (zhǎn), e.g. 一盏灯 ('a lamp').

examples.text: 因为楼梯窄，而且周经理在那儿放了旧灯箱子。
examples.trans: Because the stairs are narrow, and Manager Zhou put old lamp boxes up there.

examples.text: 隔壁的小洗手间呢？灯亮吗？
examples.trans: What about the small bathroom next door? Does the light work?

meanings.note: Pinyin: dēng guāng. Measure word (量词): 片 (piàn), e.g. 一片灯光 ('warm lamplight').

examples.text: 快拿到楼下灯光下面看看吧！
examples.trans: Let's bring it downstairs under the light and take a look!

examples.text: 插上老陈的铜台灯……哇，黄色灯光真暖和！
examples.trans: Plug in Chen's brass lamp... wow, how warm that yellow light is!

meanings.note: Pinyin: dēng zhào. Compound 灯 ('lamp') + 罩 ('cover/shade'). Measure word: 个 (gè).

examples.text: 老陈小心地擦干净了磨砂玻璃灯罩上的灰尘。
examples.trans: Chen carefully wiped the dust off the frosted glass lampshade.

examples.text: 换上奶白色的灯罩以后，灯光一点也不刺眼。
examples.trans: With the cream-white lampshade on, the light doesn't glare at all.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kǎo xiāng. Measure word (量词): 台, e.g. 一台烤箱 ('an oven').

examples.text: 还好烤箱里的面团已经准备好了。
examples.trans: Thankfully the bread dough in the oven is already ready.

examples.text: 宋老师早！我的肉桂卷刚出烤箱。
examples.trans: Morning, Teacher Song! My cinnamon rolls just came out of the oven.

片.gloss: measure word for slices, leaves, tablets

meanings.en: measure word for slices, leaves, tablets
meanings.note: Pinyin: piàn. Counts thin, flat slices of bread, lemon, cheese, or leaves (一片面包 'a slice of bread').

examples.text: 请给我不加糖的红茶，再来一片热面包。
examples.trans: Black tea without added sugar, please, and one slice of warm bread.

examples.text: 他在红茶里放了一片新鲜柠檬。
examples.trans: He put a slice of fresh lemon into his black tea.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bō li. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块玻璃 ('a pane of glass').

examples.text: 小晴，隔着玻璃看——他们俩在树下面对面站着呢！
examples.trans: Qing, look through the glass—the two of them are standing face to face under the tree!

examples.text: 擦干净玻璃窗以后，屋里亮多了。
examples.trans: After wiping the glass window clean, the room is much brighter.

related.gloss: a pane of glass (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: cí. High-fired glazed porcelain; used in 瓷杯 ('porcelain cup') and 瓷保险丝 ('porcelain fuse carrier').

examples.text: 老房子电盒里用的是结实的白瓷保险丝。
examples.trans: The junction box in the old house uses a sturdy white porcelain fuse.

examples.text: 这套薄薄的白瓷茶具是景德镇出产的。
examples.trans: This thin white porcelain tea set was made in Jingdezhen.

meanings.note: Pinyin: diàn hé. Short everyday compound 电 ('electric') + 盒 ('box') for a wall junction or fuse box.

examples.text: 新的铜电线已经安全地接进了墙角的电盒。
examples.trans: The new copper wire has been safely connected into the corner junction box.

examples.text: 打开电盒以前，老陈先关掉了总电源。
examples.trans: Before opening the junction box, Chen switched off the main power first.

meanings.note: Pinyin: diàn xiàn. Measure word (量词): 根 (gēn), e.g. 一根电线 ('an electric wire').

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 电线本来就该拉直了。正常保养，别多想。
examples.trans: The wire needed straightening anyway. Routine maintenance—don't read into it.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liú. Used for leaving a note/keepsake, saving food, or staying on (留下来).

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 为什么把鞋和木头小火车留到星期五呢？
examples.trans: Why leave the shoes and little wooden train here until Friday?

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Links modifiers or owners to nouns (我的书 'my book', 安静的院子 'quiet courtyard').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: gài zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个木头盖子 ('a wooden lid').

examples.text: 开了！老陈，快打开木头盖子！
examples.trans: It's open! Chen, quick, lift the wooden lid!

examples.text: 盖子要小心一点——它已经关了几十年了。
examples.trans: Careful with the lid—it has been closed for decades.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhí. Describes straight lines or walking straight ahead (直走).

examples.text: 出门左拐，直走到桥。要过河吗？
examples.trans: Left out the gate, straight to the bridge. Do I cross the river?

examples.text: 电线本来就该拉直了。正常保养，别多想。
examples.trans: The wire needed straightening anyway. Routine maintenance—don't read into it.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kàn. Covers looking at something, reading silently, or visiting someone; add 见/到 for 'catch sight of'.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuān. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块砖 ('a brick').

examples.text: 四米宽，六米长，左边是砖墙，上面是木头天花板。
examples.trans: Four metres wide, six metres long, a brick wall on the left, a wooden ceiling above.

examples.text: 一点也不会——很厚的砖墙挡住了楼梯那边的声音。
examples.trans: Not at all—the thick brick wall blocks the sound from the stairs.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mó shā. Literally 'ground with sand'; describes frosted glass (磨砂玻璃) that diffuses glare into a soft glow.

examples.text: 九号房的天花板上挂着一盏磨砂玻璃吊灯。
examples.trans: A frosted-glass pendant lamp hangs from the ceiling of Room Nine.

examples.text: 磨砂玻璃窗既能透光，又能保护隐私。
examples.trans: Frosted glass windows let daylight in while keeping the room private.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lí kāi. Compound 离 ('part from') + 开 ('away'); takes a direct place or object without 从.

examples.text: 开电闸以前，请先离开木梯子退后一步。
examples.trans: Before flipping the breaker, please step clear of the wooden ladder and stand back.

examples.text: 火车快开了，旅客们陆续离开候车室。
examples.trans: The train is about to depart, and passengers are leaving the waiting room one after another.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chuāng hu. Measure word (量词): 扇 (shàn), e.g. 一扇窗户 ('a window').

examples.text: 太好了。窗户朝街上还是朝院子？
examples.trans: Wonderful. Does the window face the street or the courtyard?

examples.text: 哇，看这间房！大木头房梁，窗户正对着院子！
examples.trans: Wow, look at this room! Big wooden beams, and a window facing the courtyard!

meanings.note: Pinyin: děng deng. Urgent or casual reduplication of 等 ('wait!').

examples.text: 等等，深蓝色的，跟您的一样啊！
examples.trans: Wait—it is dark blue, the same as yours!

examples.text: 等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！
examples.trans: Wait—that street is right nearby, only five minutes on foot!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jǐn. Describes tightening a valve (拧紧) or a tight schedule.

examples.text: 当心那把角落椅子，等十秒我拧紧螺丝。
examples.trans: Mind that corner chair—wait ten seconds while I tighten the screw.

examples.text: 小晴，把床单角塞紧！放上两个软枕头。
examples.trans: Qing, tuck the sheet corner tight! On go the two soft pillows.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiàn. Measure word (量词): 根 (gēn) or 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一根线 ('a wire / thread').

examples.text: 墙里的旧布线已经老化，老陈全换成了新铜线。
examples.trans: The old cloth-wrapped wire inside the wall had aged, so Chen replaced it all with new copper wire.

examples.text: 妈妈用一根白棉线把掉下来的扣子缝好了。
examples.trans: Mum sewed the fallen button back on with a length of white cotton thread.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jīng lǐ. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位经理 ('a manager').

examples.text: 周经理早！桌子很干净，钥匙也准备好了。
examples.trans: Morning, Manager Zhou! The desk is clean, and the keys are ready too.

examples.text: 放心吧，周经理。房间干净，毛巾也是新的。
examples.trans: Relax, Manager Zhou. The room is clean, and the towels are fresh.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gěi. As main verb, 'give'; as preposition/complement, marks the recipient (给你 'for/to you', 递给我 'pass to me').

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jué duì. Strong emphatic adverb.

examples.text: 而且大哥想装作镇定的时候，绝对不会早到。
examples.trans: Besides, when older brothers want to act calm, they never arrive early.

examples.text: 用咸黄油炒出来的鸡蛋绝对香！
examples.trans: Scrambled eggs made with salted butter are guaranteed to smell amazing!

meanings.note: Pinyin: luó sī. Measure word (量词): 颗 (kē), e.g. 一颗螺丝 ('a screw').

examples.text: 当心那把角落椅子，等十秒我拧紧螺丝。
examples.trans: Mind that corner chair—wait ten seconds while I tighten the screw.

examples.text: 老房子每到星期二就松一颗螺丝。坐吧。
examples.trans: Every Tuesday an old house loosens one screw. Sit down.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xíng. Read xíng when meaning 'that works / okay' (不行 'won't work'); read háng when counting lines of text (第一行).

examples.text: 等等，咸黄油配果酱不行，做炒蛋却棒极了！
examples.trans: Wait—salted butter fails with jam, yet for scrambled eggs it is amazing!

examples.text: 小晴，替我念第一行。快说是我眼镜又看花眼了！
examples.trans: Qing, read the top line for me. Tell me my glasses are playing tricks on my eyes!

meanings.en: want; need; will / be going to
meanings.note: Pinyin: yào. Direct verb for ordering/requesting ('want'), obligation ('need to'), or imminent future (要下雨了).

examples.text: 今天四号房的客人住一整个星期，一定要完美！
examples.trans: Today's guest in room four is staying a whole week; everything must be perfect!

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiàn. Appears in farewells (再见, 明天见) and as result complement of perception (看见, 听见).

examples.text: 晚安，小晴。明天早餐见。
examples.trans: Good night, Qing. See you at breakfast tomorrow.

examples.text: 老陈，听得见吗？我刚经过绿药店！
examples.trans: Chen, can you hear me? I just passed the green pharmacy!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì. Often reduplicated softly as 试试 ('give it a try').

examples.text: 我刚试了洗手池水龙头，水先是温的，马上变凉了。
examples.trans: I just tested the sink tap—the water started warm, then turned cool right away.

examples.text: 这件羊毛开衫很暖和，您试试吧。
examples.trans: This wool cardigan is very warm—try it on.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiē. Used for taping envelopes, labels, or notices onto a surface.

examples.text: 看，把手上贴着一个白信封。
examples.trans: Look, there is a white envelope taped onto the handle.

examples.text: 对。我一慌，按了门铃，把星期五纸条贴在把手上。
examples.trans: Yes. In a panic I rang the bell and taped the Friday note onto the handle.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lún dào. Verb-complement compound 轮 ('take turns') + 到 ('reach'); followed by the person whose turn has arrived.

examples.text: 电线都接好了，小晴，现在轮到你按开关啦！
examples.trans: The wires are all connected—Qing, now it's your turn to press the switch!

examples.text: 大家排好队，很快就轮到我们买热烧饼了。
examples.trans: Line up nicely—it'll be our turn to buy hot sesame flatbreads very soon.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hái. Everyday adverb meaning 'still' (还在), 'not yet' (还没), or 'even more' after 比.

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

examples.text: 宋老师，真对不起，那边还没有消息。
examples.trans: Teacher Song, I am truly sorry; they have no news over there yet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lián. Pairs with 都/也 to highlight 'even X' (连名字都一样), or means 'connect' as a verb.

examples.text: 老房子连着旧回忆——那种争吵最伤人。
examples.trans: Old houses are tied to old memories—arguments like that cut deepest.

examples.text: 笔挺又干净，周经理！连眼镜都戴在鼻子上，没在额头上。
examples.trans: Crisp and spotless, Manager Zhou! Even your glasses are on your nose instead of your forehead.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tuì hòu. Used when clearing space safely.

examples.text: 茶壶也烫好了！大家从窗边退后一步！
examples.trans: And the teapot is hot! Everybody step back from the window!

examples.text: 开烤箱门有热气，请往后退后一步。
examples.trans: Hot steam comes out when the oven opens—please step back.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dì. Used for passing tools, napkins, or cups directly from hand to hand (递给我).

examples.text: 关掉了，水也放空了。把左边那把重扳手递给我。
examples.trans: Turned off and drained. Pass me that heavy wrench on your left.

examples.text: 他双手把热茶递给客人。
examples.trans: He handed the hot tea to the guest with both hands.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nà. Distal demonstrative before measure words (那个 'that one'); at clause start, means 'then / well then'.

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dōu. Summarizes everything BEFORE it and always stands directly before the verb/adjective (我们都喜欢).

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǐ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 里面 ('the inside').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǐ miàn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 箱子里面 ('inside the suitcase').

examples.text: 我来帮您。哎呀，里面装了石头吗？
examples.trans: Let me help you. Goodness, did you pack stones inside?

examples.text: 小晴，快看里面！这不是我的箱子！
examples.trans: Qing, look inside quickly! This is not my case!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jīn sè. Measure word (量词): 种 (zhǒng), e.g. 一种金色 ('a golden color').

examples.text: 最上面架子上金色包装那包。怎么了？
examples.trans: The gold-wrapped packet on the top shelf. Why?

examples.text: 门上方只画着一把金色钥匙。拿旧阀门给店员看。
examples.trans: Only a golden key painted above the door. Show the clerk the old valve.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gāng qín. Measure word (量词): 架 (jià), e.g. 一架钢琴 ('a piano').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 何止认识！整整六年，每个星期五我都爬那座木楼梯教钢琴！
examples.trans: More than know it! Every Friday for six whole years I climbed those wooden stairs to teach piano!

meanings.note: Pinyin: tóng. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块铜 ('a piece of brass').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房今天到。
examples.trans: Right, eight guest rooms, eight brass keys. Room four arrives today.

examples.text: 楼下我的工具房里有一盏铜台灯。
examples.trans: Downstairs in my workshop there is a brass desk lamp.

related.gloss: a piece of brass (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: miàn bǎn. Compound 面 ('surface/face') + 板 ('plate/board'): flat cover plate of a wall switch or control panel.

examples.text: 铜开关面板用两颗小螺丝紧紧固定在砖墙上。
examples.trans: The brass switch faceplate is fastened tightly against the brick wall with two small screws.

examples.text: 装好灯以后，老陈用干布擦亮了开关面板。
examples.trans: After installing the lamp, Chen polished the switch plate bright with a dry cloth.

颗.gloss: measure word for small round things

meanings.en: measure word for small round things
meanings.note: Pinyin: kē. Counts stars, pearls, beans, buttons, and hearts (一颗星 'a star').

examples.text: 老房子每到星期二就松一颗螺丝。坐吧。
examples.trans: Every Tuesday an old house loosens one screw. Sit down.

examples.text: 小盘子里放着五颗新鲜草莓。
examples.trans: Five fresh strawberries sit on the small plate.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hēi. Describes black color or no light; 灯黑了 means the lights went out.

examples.text: 大厅的灯黑了！我把厨房的烤箱也弄坏了吗？
examples.trans: The lobby lamp went dark! Did I break the kitchen oven too?

examples.text: 天黑了，我们回去吧。
examples.trans: It's getting dark; let's head back.
